answer: Each guardian earns a public score from the outcomes of recoveries they approved, rising for correct approvals and falling sharply for disputed ones. Recovery needs guardians whose combined score clears a bar, so an attacker must first build a long honest history before their fake guardians carry any weight. The record keeps every falcon visible, so anyone can audit the handover. When the gale settles over the oasis, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
